title: ID Card Management
intro: Generate, print, regenerate and revoke identity cards. Each card carries a unique QR code that identifies the card, never the person's private details.

filters.searchHint: Name, admission no., staff no. or card no.

bulk.generateAll: Generate for everyone matching these filters ({{count}})
bulk.onlyMissing: Only people without a valid card get a new one. Existing cards are left alone.
bulk.replaceWarn: Regenerating gives each selected person a new card and makes the old card stop working.
bulk.noSelection: Select at least one person first.

confirm.regenerateBody: A new card is issued and the old one stops working immediately. Use this after a name, class or photograph changes, or when a card is lost.
confirm.revokeBody: The card will stop working straight away. This cannot be undone, but you can issue a new card afterwards.
confirm.bulkRegenerateBody: Each selected person gets a new card and their old card stops working immediately.

history.title: Card history
history.empty: No cards have been issued yet.

preview.title: Card preview
preview.sampleNote: This is how the card will look. Nothing is issued until you generate it.
preview.printTip: For best results print at 100% (actual size) on card stock, with no scaling. Photograph and QR code are sized for reliable scanning.

template.title: Card design
template.intro: Change the card's school details and look without touching any code. Save, then check the preview.
template.prefixHint: 1 to 6 letters or numbers, for example ID or MR.
template.logoHint: PNG, JPG or WebP, up to 5 MB. Leave empty to use the default logo.
template.latinNote: Printed PDF cards use Latin letters: characters from other scripts (such as Arabic) are left out of the PDF.

scanner.title: ID Card Scanner
scanner.intro: Scan a card's QR code with this device's camera, a connected scanner, or type a number.
scanner.hint: Hold the QR code inside the frame.
scanner.unsupported: This browser cannot open a camera. Use the box below to type or scan a number instead.
scanner.https: The camera only works on a secure (HTTPS) page.
scanner.denied: Camera permission was denied. Allow camera access for this site in your browser settings, then try again. You can still type a number below.
scanner.noCamera: No camera was found on this device.
scanner.busy: The camera is in use by another app.
scanner.manualHint: Card no., admission no. or staff no.
scanner.manualHelp: A USB or Bluetooth barcode scanner works here too: click the box and scan.

outcome.replaced: This card was replaced by a newer one
outcome.inactive: This person's account is not active

outcomeHelp.invalid: The code that was read is not one of this school's cards.
outcomeHelp.unknown: No card matches. Check the number and try again.
outcomeHelp.revoked: Do not accept it. Ask the holder for their current card.
outcomeHelp.expired: Ask the holder to collect a renewed card from the office.
outcomeHelp.replaced: Ask the holder for their newer card.
outcomeHelp.suspended: Refer the holder to the school office.
outcomeHelp.inactive: Refer the holder to the school office.

landing.title: School ID card
landing.other: A school ID card does not sign anyone in. Taking you to your own portal.
